title: 第15章 浩然正气第16章 自创新篇
content_zh:
【符箓文章：符文成句，符句书章。天地奇文，感应华光。】
符文是天地文字，凝结了天地奥秘。
光是一枚单独的符文，写作出来，也各有奇能。
若是连贯成句，承载法意，倍显奇效。
要是符句成章，则能奇文感应天地，自生异象。
平常修士，哪怕精通符道，要想符文成句，法意连贯，已是极难。
更别说，承前启后，一气呵成，以符句书写华章了。
吴燃灯是以字入道，符箓入玄，使用字符已成了自身本能，又是秀才读书人出身，胸中自有文章，心意所至，符文自成，才有这心力和灵感，一气书写出符章。
这或许就是以字符仙业入道的另一重好处。
上三次第入道，妙用无方，渐渐显露，远超灵根宝体的感气之能，这一点就连吴燃灯自身也是知晓不多，也在摸索中慢慢体会。
【符章：入门（6100）】
此时命格属性一栏，符章已经作为技能一栏彻底凝固了下来。
并且符章一成，灵气浇灌。
原本寸步难行的境界，也一举突破到脱胎大境的第一境，炼气。
吴燃灯正式成了货真价实的修士，修为在身，之后施展手段，能自发调息回气，持久力大增，就不用刻意静坐吐纳了。
这就是仙业的妙处，成就仙业，体会其背后的玄机，福泽自身。
若是能长久沉浸，单凭修行之路，也未必弱了那灵根宝体多少，更有淬炼心神，精进功业的多重好处。
仙道功业，能被列为上三次第，绝不是毫无缘由的。
但这只是第一步，前方的路还很远。
修仙学问高如天，修行的功夫也是深似渊。

每一境，都各有炼法，极尽玄机与复杂。
这第一境炼气，又以气、汽、炁，划分为下、中、上三品。
气为异种灵气，为修士独有气机，才能有不同凡俗的手段。
汽为气之形变，灵气变化妙用，寒气凝冰雨，炎气生火雷。
炁为气汽质变，返本先天，不受五行生克，自生阴阳六合。
……
“炼气已成，该炼何种灵气呢？”
吴燃灯念头一滑而过，很快就做出了决定。
就炼儒家的浩然正气！
儒家有云：吾善养吾浩然之气。
他未入道时，本就是儒家秀才，写文章早就深入骨髓，炼化起来驾轻就熟，占着先天的优势。
而且异种灵气的属性生克，往往决定了修士的瓶颈和破绽。
儒家浩然正气，虽然并无多少奇妙异力，但浩然正气，也不为其他灵气所克，四平八稳，以底蕴胜之。
而吴燃灯自忖自身，一证永证，只要不停止读道经，无时无刻不在进步，最不缺的就是底蕴。
一旦底蕴积蓄成势，煌煌大势足以压倒一切玄机诡诈。
随后他又开始提笔写符起来。
此时他已经找到了自身的修行方法，仙业为动，吐纳为静，动静结合，内外交感，以仙业为依，勾动天地灵气，淬炼自身。
妙笔符句在他手下蜿蜒而出，蔚然成章，灵光四溢。
手在动，吴燃灯心却越静，默运《正气感应妙诀》，引动灵气入体，推动周天，将灵气渐渐朝着儒家浩然正气所转化。
但练着练着，他就皱起眉头来。

体内灵气漩涡旋转，不断壮大，淬炼精纯，速度并不慢，但却没有一点向朝着浩然正气转化，阳刚正大的意味。
content_en:
[Fulu articles: runes into sentences, talisman sentences and book seals. The wonders of heaven and earth evoke the brilliance. 】
Runes are the words of heaven and earth, condensing the secrets of heaven and earth.
Just a single rune has its own unique abilities when written.
If it is coherently formed into a sentence and carries the meaning of the law, it will be doubly miraculous.
If the talismans are formed into a chapter, the strange words can sense the heaven and earth and create visions of their own.
For ordinary monks, even if they are proficient in Talismanism, it is extremely difficult for them to form sentences with runes and make the meaning of the law coherent.
Not to mention, it connects the past and the future in one go, writing a beautiful chapter with talismans.
Wu Randeng entered Taoism through characters and entered the mysteries through talismans. The use of characters has become his own instinct. He was also a scholar and scholar. He had articles in his mind, and the talismans formed themselves according to his thoughts. Only then did he have the energy and inspiration to write the talismans in one breath.
This may be another benefit of entering Taoism through character immortality.
The last three times he entered the Tao, his magical power was incomparable, and it was gradually revealed that his ability to sense qi far surpassed that of the spiritual root treasure body. Even Wu Randeng himself didn't know much about this, and he slowly realized it through trial and error.
[Spell: Getting Started (6100)]
At this time, the fate attribute column and the talisman have been completely solidified as the skill column.
And once the talisman is completed, spiritual energy is poured out.
The realm that was originally difficult to move has also broken through to the first realm of rebirth, refining qi.
Wu Randeng officially became a genuine monk. With his cultivation in his body, he later used methods to spontaneously adjust his breath and regain his energy. His endurance was greatly increased, so he no longer had to sit quietly and breathe out.
This is the beauty of immortality. Achieving immortality, understanding the mystery behind it, and blessing yourself.
If you can immerse yourself in it for a long time, the spiritual root treasure body may not be weakened by the path of cultivation alone. It will also have multiple benefits of tempering your mind and improving your achievements.
There is absolutely no reason why immortal achievements can be listed as the third level.
But this is only the first step, and there is still a long way to go.
The knowledge of cultivating immortals is as high as the sky, and the skill of cultivation is as deep as the abyss.
Each realm has its own refining method, which is extremely mysterious and complicated.
This first stage of refining qi is divided into three levels: lower, middle and upper levels based on qi, steam and qi.
Qi is a different kind of spiritual energy, and it is a unique Qi machine for monks, so they can use methods that are different from ordinary people.
Steam is the transformation of qi, spiritual qi changes magically, cold qi condenses into ice and rain, and flaming qi generates fire and thunder.
Qi is a change in the quality of qi and vapor, returning to its original innate nature. It is not restrained by the five elements and generates yin and yang and Liuhe by itself.
…
"Now that you have refined your Qi, what kind of spiritual energy should you refine?"
Wu Randeng's thoughts passed by and he quickly made a decision.
Just practice the great righteousness of Confucianism!
Confucianism has a saying: I am good at cultivating my awe-inspiring spirit.
Before he entered Taoism, he was a Confucian scholar. Writing articles had already been deeply rooted in his bones, and he was very proficient in refining, which gave him an innate advantage.
Moreover, the attributes of alien spiritual energy often determine the monk's bottlenecks and weaknesses.
Although the Confucian Haoran Zhengqi does not have many magical powers, the Haoran Zhengqi is not overcome by other spiritual energies. It is stable and wins over it with its foundation.
And Wu Randeng thought to himself that once he has a certificate, he will have a permanent certificate. As long as he does not stop reading the Taoist scriptures and makes progress all the time, the most important thing is the foundation.
Once the foundation accumulates momentum, the brilliant momentum is enough to overwhelm all mysteries and deceptions.
Then he started writing talismans again.
At this time, he has found his own way of practice. Immortal karma is used as movement, exhalation and breathing are stillness, movement and stillness are combined, internal and external communication is carried out, relying on celestial beings, arousing the aura of heaven and earth, and tempering himself.
The wonderful strokes and sentences meandered out under his hands, forming a clear chapter and overflowing with inspiration.
As his hands moved, Wu Randeng's heart became calmer and quieter. He silently used the "Secret of Inducing Righteousness" to induce the spiritual energy to enter the body, push the heaven and earth, and gradually transform the spiritual energy into the Confucian aura of righteousness.
But as he practiced, he started to frown.
The spiritual energy vortex in the body rotates, growing and refining, and the speed is not slow, but it does not mean that it is transforming towards Haoran's righteousness, masculinity and uprightness.
